title: Beyond Autoregression: Diffusion Language Model is All Analog In-Memory Computing Need
abstract: arXiv:2611.32223v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Analog in-memory computing (AIMC) enables energy-efficient language-model inference, but hardware non-idealities perturb matrix--vector multiplications and degrade generation quality. Autoregressive (AR) models are especially vulnerable: each token is committed to the causal context at birth, so perturbation-induced errors cascade. We study diffusion language models (DLMs), which iteratively refine a masked sequence, as an alternative paradigm. Across scale-matched model pairs and open checkpoints, DLMs degrade more gracefully than AR counterparts under persistent weight perturbations. Controlled analyses rule out cross-round noise averaging and support delayed token commitment and progressive context resolution as the mechanism. A larger denoising-step budget further shrinks the clean--noisy gap, a DLM-specific latency--robustness knob. translated_title: 超越自回归：扩散语言模型正是模拟内存计算所需要的
translated_abstract: 模拟内存计算（AIMC）能够实现高能效的语言模型推理，但硬件的非理想性会扰动矩阵-向量乘法运算，从而降低生成质量。自回归（AR）模型对此尤其脆弱：每个词元在生成之初就被固定写入因果上下文，因此扰动引发的误差会不断级联累积。我们研究了扩散语言模型（DLMs）——一种通过迭代精炼掩码序列的模型——作为替代范式。在规模匹配的模型对以及开源检查点上，DLMs在持续权重扰动下比对应的AR模型退化得更加平缓。受控分析排除了跨轮次噪声平均的解释，并支持“延迟词元提交”和“渐进式上下文解析”作为其鲁棒性机制。更大的去噪步数预算可进一步缩小干净条件与噪声条件之间的差距，这是DLM特有的延迟-鲁棒性调节旋钮。我们使用校准的噪声模型，在多样化的数据集和模型上进行了大规模仿真测试……
tldr: 该论文发现扩散语言模型在模拟内存计算的硬件噪声扰动下比自回归模型显著更鲁棒，其机制在于延迟词元提交与渐进式上下文解析避免了误差级联，且更大的去噪步数预算可作为延迟与鲁棒性之间的调节手段。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that diffusion language models are inherently more robust than autoregressive models to hardware non-idealities in analog in-memory computing, due to delayed token commitment and progressive context resolution that prevent error cascades, with a larger denoising-step budget serving as a DLM-specific latency-robustness knob.
